snippet.description:
Learn how to find the envelope of a family of curves in differential calculus. Step-by-step solved examples of envelope of curves, parabola, and circles for B.Sc. Mathematics & engineering students.

Namaste learners! Welcome back to Fractal Frontier Maths.

Is video lecture me hum Differential Calculus ka ek important topic cover kar rahe hain — Envelope of Family of Curves (वक्रतुल का एनवेलोप). Pichhle lecture ke basic concept ke baad, is class me hum complex aur practical problems ko solve karna seekhenge jahan geometrical conditions ki help se pehle family of curves construct ki jaati hai aur fir parameter eliminate karke envelope calculate kiya jata hai.

📌 Topics Covered in This Video:

Quick Revision: Envelope definition, parameter elimination & quadratic condition ($B^2 - 4AC = 0$)
Constructing the family of curves using geometric properties
Solved Problem: Parabola $y^2 = 4ax$ ki double ordinates ko diameter mankar banaye gaye circles ka envelope prove karna ($y^2 = 4a(x + a)$)
Step-by-step differentiation and parameter elimination methods
B.Sc. 1st Year / Engineering Maths ke exam point of view se standard questions

Timestamps
00:00 – Introduction & Envelope Recap
01:43 – Example 1: Circles on Double Ordinates of Parabola ($y^2 = 4ax$)
07:02 – Constructing Equation of Circles using Diameter Form
09:30 – Finding the Envelope using Quadratic Condition ($B^2 - 4AC = 0$)
13:20 – Example 2: Envelope of Lines Joining Ends of Semi-Conjugate Diameters of Ellipse
16:00 – Parametric Coordinates & Equation of the Chord
23:12 – Differentiating w.r.t. Parameter $\theta$ & Eliminating Parameter
28:02 – Alternative Method using Coordinate Geometry Formula
31:31 – Example 3: Envelope of Lines Perpendicular to Radius Vectors of Cardioid ($r = a(1 + \cos\theta)$)
36:26 – Partial Differentiation & Parameter Elimination
41:51 – Example 4: Envelope of Circles on Radius Vectors of $r^n = a^n \cos(n\theta)$
44:42 – Differentiation & Finding Required Envelope
49:09 – Summary & Upcoming Two-Parameter Family Preview

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨
